(1) Compare Cal. Civil Code § 1624(a)(3), N.Y. Gen. Oblig. L. § 5-
703(1), and Ohio Rev. Code§ 1335.04, all of which are in the Selections book. 
Based on these provisions, in which of these states must a one-year lease of 
real property be in a sufficient writing in order to be enforceable'? See Ohio 
Rev. Code§ 5301.08. 
(2) Able, Baker, and Charlie entered into an oral contract under which
